column1: Unique ID to each irrigation network component. The ID is the official nomenclature from Klambu Wilalung Irrigation District.
column2: The name of each irrigation network component
column3: The type of component in the irrigation network (1=structure, 2=canal)
column4: The status of irrigation network components. For structures (1=main structures, 2=supporting structures). For canals (1=primary canal, 2=secondary canal).
column5: The Easting coordinate in UTM Projection System
column6: The Northing coordinate in UTM Projection System
column7: The WUA for which each irrigation network components situated
column8: The village for which each irrigation network components situated
